command:
set -eu
echo QD_DATA_START
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
cat /proc/uptime
i=0
for p in /factory_peq/tcon_data/QD/*.bin; do
 test -f "$p"
 test ! -L "$p"
 i=$((i+1))
 test "$i" -le 20
 echo FILE
 stat -c '%n %s %u:%g:%a' "$p"
 n=$(wc -c < "$p")
 if test "$n" -le 4194304; then sha256sum "$p"; else echo HASH_SKIPPED_SIZE; fi
 echo HEADER64
 head -c 64 "$p" | od -An -tx1
done
echo "FILE_COUNT=$i"
echo QD_DATA_END
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
cat /proc/uptime
mode: existing regular file metadata/hash/64byte header only
